content: Bitwarden's passkey provider patches navigator.credentials.create/get by injecting a page-world script that reassigns the methods (native originals saved in closure vars for fallback). Messaging hops: page script -> pageScriptMessenger -> content script -> contentScriptMessenger -> background script -> FIDO2 client/vault. Sensitive crypto/vault ops stay in the background context; page and content-script layers only relay serialized requests/responses.
